verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud file-storage product, since self-hostable alternatives exist. However, nothing in the evidence shows Google Drive offers a self-hosted or on-prem deployment; every item describes the Google-hosted service, its APIs, or Google One storage plans. Community mentions of rclone backups are user-side workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
